children: Overview
China auto dealership's H1 revenue fell 18.5% yr/yr amid weaker vehicle demand
Net income attributable to shareholders dropped 89.1% from a year earlier
Company cites market weakness, store closures and structural shifts for profit decline
Outlook
Company targets NEV brand sales to reach 35% of total volume on a run rate basis in Dec 2026
Zhongsheng expects to operate 300 NEV brand stores by year-end
Result Drivers
WEAK VEHICLE DEMAND - Co said structurally weak consumer confidence and spending power led to lower new vehicle sales volume
STORE CLOSURES - Closure, suspension, merger, or transfer of 66 underperforming traditional brand stores weighed on sales and profit
AFTER-SALES SERVICES RESILIENCE - After-sales services revenue and gross profit grew modestly, supported by focus on higher-revenue repairs and operational improvements

Analyst Coverage
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 7 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and 3 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the auto vehicles, parts & service retailers peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Zhongsheng Group Holdings Limited is HK$11.15, about 171% above its August 28 closing price of HK$4.12
The stock recently traded at 3 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 6 three months ago
